runs.method: At a simple sine/cosine zero, analytic amplitude zero makes the original quotient tend to zero; nonzero amplitude gives opposite slopes. Piecewise derivatives require both adjacent quotients relative to the actual selected value; shadowed equality branches do not change it. Oscillatory x² sin(1/x)=O(x²) has removable slope zero only if the selected point value is zero.
